name: LeadDesk
description_en:
LeadDesk offers outbound calling and customer-service workflows with dialers, reporting, CTI integrations and optional applications. It belongs on a phone-heavy team’s shortlist when agents and supervisors need shared operating controls. Its customer-service and outbound packages should be scoped separately; the homepage’s broad feature family does not mean every license includes all AI, workforce and omnichannel functions.

For an evaluation, define the approved contact list and call outcome fields, configure agent access and telephony, then test a small campaign while a supervisor reviews outcomes and reports. Verify CRM integration and number requirements before importing the full list. The trial requires a valid business email and mobile number, and each trial call is disconnected after ninety seconds. That makes it unsuitable for measuring a normal long sales conversation.
description_zh:
LeadDesk 提供外呼与客户服务流程，包括拨号器、报表、CTI 集成与可选应用。当坐席和主管需要共享运营控制时，可将它列入电话业务团队候选。客户服务与外呼套餐应分别确定范围；首页的广泛功能家族不代表每张许可都包含全部 AI、排班与全渠道功能。

评估时可先确定经授权名单与通话结果字段，配置坐席访问和电话，再由主管检查小型活动的结果与报表。导入完整名单前先核对 CRM 集成及号码条件。试用需有效企业邮箱与手机号，每通试用电话九十秒后断开，因此不适合用来衡量正常的长销售会话。

steps.en: For an evaluation, define the approved contact list and call outcome fields, configure agent access and telephony, then test a small campaign while a supervisor reviews outcomes and reports. Verify CRM integration and number requirements before importing the full list. The trial requires a valid business email and mobile number, and each trial call is disconnected after ninety seconds. That makes it unsuitable for measuring a normal long sales conversation.
steps.zh: 评估时可先确定经授权名单与通话结果字段，配置坐席访问和电话，再由主管检查小型活动的结果与报表。导入完整名单前先核对 CRM 集成及号码条件。试用需有效企业邮箱与手机号，每通试用电话九十秒后断开，因此不适合用来衡量正常的长销售会话。

items.en: The trial terms identify the service as SaaS with automatic software updates. They do not establish an open-source distribution. Calling minutes, telephony integration, support and optional applications need explicit scope; the trial page itself lists only one month of included support. If a call fails, check telephony and campaign state before redialing, and reconcile the result before CRM replay. This is evaluation guidance, not a verified recovery procedure or uptime promise.
items.zh: 试用条款把服务定义为自动更新的软件即服务，没有证明存在开源发行版。通话分钟、电话集成、支持与可选应用均需明确范围；试用页本身只列一个月支持。呼叫失败时应先检查电话与活动状态再重拨，重写 CRM 前先对账。这是评估建议，不是已经验证的恢复程序或可用率承诺。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: Pricing lists Instant €99/license/month with a ten-license minimum, Essential €109 from ten, Advanced €139 from ten, and Enterprise by quote from fifty. Advanced includes API access and more LeadApps. Trial terms describe a twelve-month binding contract, a thirty-day pilot termination window without license costs, and a three-month termination notice before renewal. The trial includes 150 VoIP minutes; excess pay-per-use services and LeadApps can cost extra. Confirm the signed offer and VAT treatment.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 定价列出 Instant 每许可每月 99 欧元、最低十张；Essential 109、Advanced 139，均十张起；Enterprise 五十张起询价。Advanced 含 API 与更多 LeadApps。试用条款描述十二个月约束期、三十天试点内可终止而不收许可费，以及续约前三个月的终止通知。试用含 150 分钟 VoIP，超额按量服务与 LeadApps 可能另收费。应确认签署报价与增值税处理。
